$schema_note: DigitalOcean's real scope taxonomy and every scope string actually found in official docs. Never invent a scope string not listed here — if actions.json needs one that isn't present, mark it 'not_confirmed', don't guess.

naming_inconsistency_flagged.note: Both strings appear in the same official scope listing page (singular 'spaces_key' vs plural 'spaces_keys'). Not resolved as of 2026-08-17 — use spaces_key:create_credentials unless disproven by a live test.

separate_credential_systems_not_scope_ba.notes: Used only for the S3-compatible Spaces data-plane host, not api.digitalocean.com. Distinct from spaces_key:* scopes, which govern managing the key resource itself via the standard v2 API.
Used for Serverless Inference and Batch Inference (inference.do-ai.run host). Dedicated Inference uses standard v2 scopes instead.

token_lifecycle_facts.pat_scope_mutability: immutable after creation — must issue a new token to change scope
token_lifecycle_facts.pat_expiry: user-set interval at creation time; full option list not enumerated in fetched docs
token_lifecycle_facts.team_role_change_effect: retroactively affects Read-Only/Full-Access PATs but NOT Custom-Scope PATs
